channel.title: andrews.sh journal
channel.description: Site updates, tiny victories and things I broke on purpose.

item.title: moved to Cloudflare and added everything
item.description: Moved the whole site to Cloudflare Workers and added guestbook, shoutbox, poll, hit counter, virtual pet, a quiz, a fake webcam, wallpapers and approximately one million links.

item.title: Spotify token rotation
item.description: Spotify refresh tokens now expire every six months. Rotated ours, wrote a little auth helper, and added a clearer error message for when it happens again.

item.title: vinyl record widgets
item.description: Added the vinyl record widgets for currently playing, top artists and top tracks. They spin. That is the whole feature.

item.title: cybercore redesign
item.description: Redesigned the site around the cybercore palette: black, purple, neon green, tiled star background, scanlines.

item.title: site opened
item.description: Site opened. Hello, world. Guestbook installed. Hit counter reset to zero for the hundredth time.
